abilities.name: Death Guard Defenders
abilities.text: While this model is within 3" of one or more friendly ^^**Death Guard Infantry^^** units, this model has the Lone Operative ability.

abilities.name: Fevered Strategist
abilities.text: Once per Battle Round, one model from your army with this ability can use it when a friendly ^^**Death Guard^^** unit within 12" of that model is targeted with a Stratagem. If it does, reduce the CP cost of that Stratagem by 1CP.

abilities.name: Miasma of Pestilence (Aura)
abilities.text: While a friendly ^^**Death Guard^^** unit is within 6" of this model, each time a ranged attack targets that unit, models in that unit have the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

abilities.name: Host of the Hybridised Pox
abilities.text: (Once per battle, per army) In your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, select one of the **Plagues** listed in **Nurgle’s Gift** (see Codex: Death Guard). abilities.name: Rejuvenating Swarm
abilities.text: Attacks that target this unit with a **S** greater than this unit’s **T** have ‑1 to **wound rolls**.

abilities.name: Daemon Weapon of Nurgle
abilities.text: Each time the bearer makes a melee attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

abilities.name: Furnace of Plagues
abilities.text: Add 1 to the Strength and Attacks characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons, and the bearer's melee weapons have the Devastating Wounds abilty.

abilities.name: Lord of the Walking Pox
abilities.text: If the bearer is leading a ^^**Poxwalkers**^^ unit, and is in Strategic Reserves, for the purposes of setting up that unit on the battlefield, treat the current battle round as the third battle round.

abilities.name: Revolting Regeneration
abilities.text: The bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

abilities.name: Eye of Affliction
abilities.text: Ranged weapons equipped by model's in the bearer's unit have the [Ignores Cover] ability while targeting an Afflicted enemy unit.

abilities.name: Talisman of Burgeoning
abilities.text: While the bearer is leading a ^^**Poxwalkers**^^ unit, add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of ^^**Poxwalkers**^^ models in that unit.

abilities.name: Witherbone Pipes
abilities.text: While the bearer is leading a ^^**Poxwalkers**^^ unit, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit, and each time that unit takes a Battle-shock or Leadership test, add 1 to that test.

abilities.name: Sorrowsyphon
abilities.text: While the bearer is leading a ^^**Poxwalkers**^^ unit, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the bearer's Plague Wind weapon. Each time the bearer makes one or more attacks with a Plague Wind weapon, after the bearer's unit has resolved its attacks, D3 Bodyguard models from the bearer's unit are destroyed.

abilities.name: Face of Death
abilities.text: At the start of the Fight phase, each enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer's unit must take a Battle-shock test.

abilities.name: Vile Vigour
abilities.text: While the bearer is leading a unit, add 1" to the Movement characteristics of models in that unit and you can re-roll Advance rolls made for that unit.

abilities.name: Warprot Talisman
abilities.text: Once per battle, at the end of your opponent's turn, if the bearer's unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove it from the battle field and place it into Strategic Reserves.

abilities.name: Helm of the Fly King
abilities.text: While the bearer is leading a unit, models in that unit cannot be targeted by ranged attacks unless the attacking model is within 18".

abilities.name: Arch Contaminator
abilities.text: While the bearer's unit is within range of an objective marker you control, each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

abilities.name: Bilemaw Blight
abilities.text: At the start of your Shooting phase, until the end of the phase, add 12" to the Range characteristics of the bearer's Plague Wind weapon.

abilities.name: Shriekworm Familiar
abilities.text: Once per battle round, you can target the bearer's unit with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem for 0CP.

abilities.name: Tendrilous Emissions
abilities.text: While the bearer is within 3" of one or more friendly ^^**Death Guard Vehicle**^^ units, the bearer has the Lone Operative ability, and each time one of those ^^**Vehicle**^^ units makes a ranged attack that targets an enemy unit visible to the bearer, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

abilities.name: Final Ingredient
abilities.text: Once per battle, after the bearer's unit has fought, if one or more ^^**Character**^^ models were destroyed by those attacks, select one Plague. Until the end of the battle, if an enemy unit is Afflicted, that unit has the effect of the selected Plague in addition to any other.

abilities.name: Visions of Virulence
abilities.text: While an enemy unit is enfeebled by the bearer's Pestilent Fallout ability, that unit is also Afflicted.

abilities.name: Needle of Nurgle
abilities.text: Each time the bearer uses its Tainted Narthecium ability, you can return up to D3 destroyed models to the bearer's unit (instead of 1).

abilities.name: Cornucophagus
abilities.text: In the Declare Battle Formations step, select one Plague. Until the end of the battle, while an enemy is within Contagion Range of the bearer, that enemy unit has the effect of that Plague in addition to any other.

abilities.name: Beckoning Blight
abilities.text: Each time a ^^**Plague Legions^^** unit from your army is set up on the battle field using the Deep Strike ability, if it is set up wholly within 12" of the bearer, it can be set up anywhere that is more than 6" horizontally away from any enemy models, instead of more than 8".

abilities.name: Fell Harvester
abilities.text: Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of the bearer's melee weapons.

abilities.name: Entropic Knell
abilities.text: In the Battle-shock step of your opponent's Command phase, each enemy unit within 6" of the bearer that is below its Starting Strength must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.

abilities.name: Tome of Bounteous Blessings
abilities.text: Each time a ^^**Plague Legions^^** unit within 12" of the bearer takes a Battle-shock test, add 1 to that test and, if that test is passed, one model in that unit regains up to D3 lost wounds (if that unit is a ^^**Battleline^^** unit and that test is passed, up to D3 destroyed models can be returned to that unit instead).

abilities.text: Add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for this model's unit.

abilities.name: Veil of Flies
abilities.text: Models in this model's unit have the Stealth ability.

abilities.name: Febrile Vitality
abilities.text: Add 1" to the Move characteristic of models in this model's unit.

abilities.name: Billowing Miasma
abilities.text: Add 6" to this model's Contagion Range.

abilities.name: Grossly Swollen
abilities.text: Add 2 to this model's Wounds characteristic.

abilities.name: Leprous Insensibility
abilities.text: This model has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

abilities.name: Writhing Tentacles
abilities.text: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by this model.

abilities.name: Touch of Rot
abilities.text: Improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by this model by 1.

abilities.text: Each time this model makes an attack that targets an Afflicted unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

abilities.name: Nurgle's Gift (Aura)
abilities.text:
If your Army Faction is DEATH GUARD, while an enemy unit is within Contagion Range of one or more ^^**Death Guard^^** units from your army, it is Afflicted.

CONTAGION RANGE
1st Battle Round: Contagion Range = 3"
2nd Battle Round: Contagion Range = 6"
3rd Battle Round Onwards: Contagion Range = 9"

Contagion Range cannot be greater than 12" after modifiers.

**Skullsquirm Blight**
Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

**Rattlejoint Ague**
Worsen the Save characteristic of models in this unit by 1.

**Scabrous Soulrot**
Worsen the Move, Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in this unit by 1 (this rule can only worsen a model's Objective Control characteristic to a minimum of 1).
